name: Anson Han
tagline: Designed for You. Delivered for Them.
subheading: I craft precise copy by doing deep research, studying your past speech, your posture, your style, and your beliefs word for word. We look at three main areas: deep research, style matching, and total focus.
siteDescription: The writing portfolio of Anson Han: research-led articles, copywriting, ghostwriting, essays and editing.
shortBio: Student writer with simple past writing experience for private clients.
about: I write for readers who are busy, curious and unwilling to fight their way through vague language. My work begins with understanding the idea properly, then shaping it into something clear, useful and memorable.
I am especially drawn to science, education, technology and thoughtful personal writing. I can also adapt tone for websites, founder posts, articles and editorial projects.

I am early in my professional journey, so I compete on preparation, responsiveness and care. I do not pretend to know what I do not know; I research it, ask better questions and revise until the writing earns its place.
contactIntro: Tell me what you are trying to communicate, who needs to understand it and what a successful result would look like.
guardianNotice: For formal contracts and payments, a guardian might be required
footerLine: Clear thinking. Precise language. Honest work.

principles.title: Clarity before cleverness
principles.text: The reader should understand the point before admiring the sentence.

principles.title: Research with restraint
principles.text: Evidence should strengthen the argument, not bury it under unnecessary detail.

principles.title: Voice, not imitation
principles.text: Ghostwriting should sound like the client on their clearest and most thoughtful day.

principles.title: Revision is the work
principles.text: The first draft discovers the idea. The later drafts make it worth reading.
